availability.note: KGM AU configurator serves two Musso EV MY26 grades: 2WD $60,000 and AWD $64,000 national drive-away, private buyer. Black Edge is not a configurator grade; the model page calls it 'A styling pack for the Musso EV'.

listPrice.note: CarExpert spec page: 'prices starting at $57,130' before on-road costs, against $60,000 drive-away. KGM itself publishes only a flat national drive-away ($60,000; GoAuto calls it 'national driveaway'; configurator disclaimer says it includes an estimated dealer delivery charge). CarsGuide price page lists the same 2WD $57,130 (MSRP footnote). Direction check: list $57,130 through calc/onroad.js (ute) gives a VIC drive-away of $59,553 approx, below KGM's $60,000, so the drive-away is genuine and carries dealer delivery plus NSW-level on-roads. The ute-divisor back-out ($57,566) would overstate the list by about $436 because of that bundling, so the manufacturer-supplied list price was used.

batteryKwh.note: KGM AU MY26 spec sheet (Sept 2026 issue): 'Capacity 80.6 kWh', LFP, 371.2 V, unlabelled. CarExpert gives 80.59 kWh. Treated as usable (EV Database lists 80.6 usable / 83.0 nominal, but its page could not be opened this run).

rangeKm.note: KGM AU spec sheet footnote 2: WLTP combined. Sept 2026 sheet revised 420/380 to 419/379. Same 17-inch 245/60 wheel on both grades. CarExpert 2WD spec page still shows the launch 420 km.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: KGM AU spec sheet: WLTP combined 230 Wh/km. Battery/range gives 19.2; the WLTP figure includes charging losses, gap inside the 25% tolerance.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Tub litres unpublished. KGM AU spec sheet tub 1,345 x 1,515 x 510 mm = 1,039 L; reads 10-20% high (wheel arches ignored). Ute convention: tub volume in both boot fields.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Same tub volume as bootLitresSeatsUp (ute convention).

seats.note: Dual cab, five seatbelt positions (60/40 split rear bench).

towKg.note: KGM AU spec sheet (Sept 2026): braked 1,800 kg, towball 180 kg for 2WD. KGM model page's 'up to 2.3 tonne' is the AWD figure.

warrantyYears.note: 7 years unlimited km 'bumper to bumper'; servicing outside the dealer network allowed with invoices, so unconditional. HV battery 10 years/unlimited km.

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to byd-shark-6-dynamic-cab-chassis (1750 at $55,900), gwm-cannon-phev-ultra (1800 at $52,687) and kgm-torres-evx (1800 at $55,188); a new electric ute nameplate with no ANCAP rating, so slightly above the Torres EVX. Held value kept.

depreciationCurve.note: KGM brand convention, same curve as kgm-torres-evx. Below-mainstream evidence: KGM's 2025 sales fell 23.7% (VFACTS, per held research), the only electric-ute precedent (LDV eT60) trades around 40-50% of new after 2-3 years, no ANCAP rating (CarExpert and CarsGuide reviews, opened this run).
